title: The 7 levels of Claude most people never reach
description:
Claude has seven levels. Most people never leave level one.

Every level unlocks a new type of access.
Level 1 is where most people stay forever.
Not because it's hard to go further.
Because nobody showed them the staircase.
Level 7 users aren't smarter.
They just know more floors exist.

Like staying in the hotel lobby. There are six more floors up there.

The gap isn't skill. It's knowing the other six floors exist. Start climbing.

#claudeai #aimastery #aibusiness #productivity #startups
